title: Rabbi Chanina, Father of Rabbi Acha
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Tanchuma, Naso 4: “Our Rabbis said in the name of Rabbi Chanina, the father of Rabbi Acha: The adulterer and adulteress transgress the Ten Commandments.” In Bamidbar Rabbah 9:12 it reads Rav Huna, the father of Rabbi Acha. In Tanchuma, Shelach 27: “Rabbi Tanchuma bar Abba opened in the name of Rabbi Chanina, the father of Rabbi Acha.”

notes.text: The consulted Buber Tanchuma names Chanina as the father of Acha. Bamidbar Rabbah gives Rav Huna in the corresponding discussion.
